answer: Willow-comet heartbeat bond: each identity locks 70 under one key. A comet sweeps each epoch at a random minute: every agent answers a compute heartbeat in one hour, signed with its vault key, posted to the willow ledger. Late or copied answers burn the vault bond; peers re-run 5%. First 45, kth 45+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500, pool 40,000. Rented nodes lack the key: the rented-heartbeat ring fails. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep the bond.
